facts.text: Notre Dame of Maryland University was the first Catholic college for women in America to provide the four-year collegiate education previously available only to men.

sources.title: About Notre Dame of Maryland University's School of Nursing
sources.quote: We were the first Catholic college for women in America to offer the rigorous four-year education that men already received.

facts.text: Embracing the vision of the School Sisters of Notre Dame, the university promotes the advancement of women and delivers liberal arts education in the Catholic tradition.

sources.title: University Mission | Notre Dame of Maryland University
sources.quote: Embracing the vision of the founders, the School Sisters of Notre Dame, the University promotes the advancement of women and provides a liberal arts education in the Catholic tradition.
